jobs.occupation: Senior Category Manager – Marketing (All Genders) (Category-Manager/in)

jobs.occupation: Physiker (m/w/d) (Physiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM),  Forschungs-Neutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz ...
jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams.TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) asInstrument Scientist Toftof (m/f/d) You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.Your tasks include:Scientific lead of TOFTOF’s further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications.Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOFExperimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performanceMethod development in the area of neutron spectroscopyOperation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operationPursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methodsYour responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field.Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial.Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team.Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profilePersuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset.For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.deThe high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees.We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such asTUM's health offersUniversity sportsTUM's internal continuing education and training opportunitiesTUM childcare (subject to availability)Very good accessibility by public transportThe position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Customer Development Specialist (m/f/d) – Infectiology (Referent/in - Klinische Studien (CRA))
jobs.description: Job available in 4 locations: Berlin, Halle, Remote, LeipzigWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.Location:Field-based / Remote within the territory - Eastern/ Central GermanyIdeally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or BerlinDiscover Impactful WorkJoin our Clinical Customer Development team as a Clinical Customer Development Specialist and support the targeted clinical use of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.In this field-based role, you will lead clinical market development across your territory and increase awareness, acceptance and sustainable adoption of our biomarkers through targeted engagement with healthcare professionals, clinical education and development activities. In doing so, you will support the diagnosis and management of bacterial infections and sepsis, as well as antimicrobial stewardship initiatives, and contribute to advancing biomarker-guided clinical decision-making.You will take ownership of clinical market development within your territory, with the goal of increasing demand, acceptance and sustainable clinical adoption of our biomarkers. Your focus will be on clinical education, stakeholder engagement and account development, while commercial contracting and sales execution remain with our License Partners.A Day in the Life:You will lead clinical account development across hospitals and healthcare institutions within your territory and build strong, sustainable relationships with clinicians, laboratory professionals and healthcare decision-makers in areas such as Internal Medicine, Paediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, Critical Care and Antimicrobial Stewardship teams.You will identify the objectives and clinical challenges of healthcare professionals and translate these insights into targeted educational and development activities. This includes supporting the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs, as well as delivering clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.What to expect:- Drive clinical demand and adoption of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.- Engage healthcare professionals, clinical users and decision-makers across relevant medical specialties.- Analyze and prioritize accounts with high clinical development potential, identify relevant stakeholders and develop account-specific strategies to increase clinical acceptance and adoption.- Build strong, sustainable relationships with key clinical stakeholders and decision-makers.- Support the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs.- Deliver clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.- Develop account strategies together with our License Partners, align clinical development activities and support joint customer activities where appropriate.- Act as a scientific and clinical partner and actively drive market development without direct sales responsibility.- Work closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing and other Commercial teams.- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant events and scientific congresses.- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).Keys to Success:Education- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related scientific field; an advanced scientific or clinical degree is an advantage.Experience- 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics or a related environment.- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.- Experience engaging clinical users and healthcare decision-makers.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical content.- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.- Confident and persuasive engagement with medical decision-makers at different seniority levels, with the ability to conduct credible clinical discussions, constructively challenge established approaches and initiate change.- Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.- Strong initiative, influencing skills and results orientation, with the ability to identify clinical development opportunities early and systematically advance them.- Ability to build lasting relationships with clinical stakeholders and business partners.- Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional matrix organization.- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office.- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (>50%).- Fluent German and strong English communication skills.Benefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.
